News Application documentation¶

A Django news application for readers, journalists, editors and publishers. This page explains the article model, content permissions and notification services.

Article model¶

Define database models for users, publishers, article and newsletters.

class news.models.Article(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Represent a news article and its editorial approval status.

Store the article’s title, content, author and optional publisher. New articles start unapproved. Queries use newest-first ordering unless another order is requested.

Model validation checks that the author is a journalist and belongs to the selected publisher when a publisher is provided.

clean()[source]¶

Validate the article’s author and publisher relationship.

Raises:

django.core.exceptions.ValidationError – If the author is not a journalist or does not belong to the selected publisher.

Content permissions¶

Define role-based access rules for articles and newsletters.

news.permissions.can_edit_content(user, content)[source]¶

Return whether the user may edit the supplied content.

Editors may edit any content. Journalists may edit only content they authored.

Parameters:

  • user – User whose role and identity are checked.

  • content – Article or newsletter containing an author_id.

Returns:

True if editing is permitted; otherwise False.

Return type:

bool

class news.permissions.ArticlePermission[source]¶

Enforce article creation, editing and approval rules by role.

has_permission(request, view)[source]¶

Allow the action only when the caller’s role permits it.

has_object_permission(request, view, obj)[source]¶

Check read or mutation access for this content object.

class news.permissions.NewsletterPermission[source]¶

Allow staff to create newsletters and edit permitted content.

has_permission(request, view)[source]¶

Allow the action only when the caller’s role permits it.

has_object_permission(request, view, obj)[source]¶

Check read or mutation access for this content object.

Notification services¶

Send subscriber notifications and share article approvals.

news.services.notify_article_subscribers(article)[source]¶

Send article notifications to unique subscriber email addresses.

Collect subscribers of the author and, when present, the publisher. Exclude empty addresses and remove duplicates. Email delivery errors propagate to the caller.

Parameters:

article – Article whose title and content will be emailed.

Returns:

Number of unique recipient addresses.

Return type:

int

news.services.share_approved_article(article)[source]¶

Send an article’s ID to the configured approval API.

Authenticate using the author’s API token. Log request failures and return False when they occur.

Parameters:

article – Approved article to share with the API.

Returns:

True when the request succeeds; False on a request error.

Return type:

bool
